g.text: Bars: query rounds 491–500 means; labels: 2 decimals. Bold = best observed value per scenario. One seed; no error bars.

g.text: × = attack construction failed; no endpoint bar. DBA+BFL / BFL held out from training. Both RL variants use Histogram40 and 10k cached training steps.
